QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Hungry for Words
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Hirrel, Kritias's most clerky clerk.
QuestInfo.1: Hirrel managed to save exactly one book from the Ranheim Academy before it closed. Fortunately for you, it was the cookbook! He'll give it to you if you bring him #b10 Black Spellbooks#k from the #bCorrupted Advanced Magicians#k in #bCorrupted Magic Forest 3#k.

0.0: How odd. It just so happens that I managed to save a single book from the Ranheim Academy's library the day of the attack. That book was #b100 Palace Dishes#k.\r\n#L0##bGreat! Michelin is looking for that book.#l\n#k
0.1: I'm sure he'd make better use of it than me, but...\r\n#L0##bBut what?#l\n#k
0.2: This is the only book I have. I'm sorry, but I just can't give it away.\r\n#L0##bWhat're you talking about? You gave me that history book without a second thought earlier!#l\n#k
0.3: That old thing? I committed it to memory years ago. But with the library closed, this cookbook is the only thing I have to read that I haven't memorized yet...\r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
0.4: Then again, I'd also like to eat something nice. Why don't we make a deal? Bring me #b10 Black Spellbooks#k from the #bCorrupted Advanced Magicians#k. In exchange, I'll give you the cookbook!

yes.0: The #bCorrupted Advanced Magicians#k should be in #bCorrupted Magic Forest 3#k. Bring me #b10 Black Spellbooks#k, please.

no.0: Imagine how I feel! All the world's books to choose from, and I pick up a COOKBOOK? But it's all I have. You don't honestly expect me to go on without anything to read, do you?

1.0: You got them. Thank you!\r\n#L0##bSure, but these books are all gibberish...#l\n#k
1.1: Sure, sure, that's fine. Books are books.\r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
1.2: It simply means these will take longer to memorize. It's a win-win!

item.0: You can get #bBlack Spellbooks#k by defeating #bCorrupted Advanced Magicians#k in #bCorrupted Magic Forest 3#k. I think about #b10#k volumes should keep me occupied for a while.
